title: Frieza’s Nightmare 2.0
intro: My first custom Parallel Quest, now being rebuilt. Frieza’s Nightmare started in 2022 as a what-if quest. Version 2.0 adds new villain encounters, branching Super Saiyan paths and custom cutscenes.
image_alt: Gameplay still from Xeno Trunks’ Frieza’s Nightmare quest: Turles and Lord Slug face off in Xenoverse 2.

progress.item: Goku and Vegeta branching Super Saiyan paths

note: No release date yet. Version 1.7 is free to play right now.
